body_markdown:
Public Storage customers can now search for nearby locations and compare available storage options through ChatGPT. Ask location, unit-size, and feature questions in a conversational format instead of starting with a traditional search.


We’ve always believed that finding the right storage solution should be simple. Our latest innovation takes that commitment to a whole new level.


We’re excited to announce that we’ve integrated our facility search capabilities directly into ChatGPT, a significant milestone in our ongoing 4.0 digital transformation. Customers can now discover, compare, and explore our locations through natural, conversational AI, without navigating a traditional search engine or website.


By meeting customers where they already are — inside ChatGPT — we’re removing friction from one of the most important steps in the storage journey: finding the right unit, in the right location, at the right price.


## ChatGPT Storage Search Essentials:


- Search for nearby Public Storage locations through ChatGPT.
- Ask about available unit sizes, including 5×5, 10×10, and larger units.
- Compare location options based on storage features and unit needs.
- Search for[climate-controlled storage](https://www.publicstorage.com/climate-controlled-storage) and other available storage options.
- Use natural-language questions instead of browsing multiple search results.
- Confirm your selected location, unit, and rental details with Public Storage before completing a rental.

## How Does Public Storage Search Work in ChatGPT?


Public Storage search in ChatGPT lets customers ask conversational questions about nearby locations, unit sizes, and available features. ChatGPT returns Public Storage location and unit information based on available data.


Customers can search using location-based or need-based questions. For example, a customer can ask for a 10×10 unit in Dallas or nearby[climate-controlled storage](https://www.publicstorage.com/climate-controlled-storage) .


## What Can Customers Ask ChatGPT About Public Storage?


Customers can ask ChatGPT about Public Storage locations, unit sizes, and available storage features. Clear questions help ChatGPT identify relevant storage options.


**Customers can ask questions such as:**


- “What Public Storage locations are near me?”
- “I need a 10×10 unit in Dallas. What are my options?”
- “Which nearby locations have climate-controlled units?”
- “What size storage unit fits boxes and furniture from a one-bedroom apartment?”
- “Where can I find[drive-up storage](https://www.publicstorage.com/self-storage/drive-up-storage) near my new home?”
- “Which Public Storage locations have[24/7](https://www.publicstorage.com/self-storage/24-hour-storage) access?”


## How Does ChatGPT Simplify the Storage Search Process?


ChatGPT simplifies the storage search process by combining common location, unit-size, and feature questions into one conversation. Customers can compare storage options without starting separate searches for each need.


The tool supports common storage situations, including moves, apartment transitions, home projects, and seasonal organization. Customers can use the information to identify a location and unit that fit their storage plan.


## How Does This Support Public Storage 4.0?


The ChatGPT integration supports Public Storage 4.0 by expanding digital customer touchpoints and simplifying the facility-search experience. It gives customers another way to find and compare Public Storage options through conversational AI.


This capability is part of Public Storage’s ongoing work to modernize operations and improve digital experiences. The focus is direct: help customers find a storage option with fewer steps.


## Create a Simpler Storage Search.


Use ChatGPT to search for nearby Public Storage locations, compare unit sizes, and explore available features before renting. Confirm the selected location, unit details, and rental information directly with Public Storage before completing your reservation.


Ask the question. Find the space.


## Public Storage ChatGPT Search FAQs


**Can I Search for Public Storage Locations in ChatGPT?**
Yes. You can ask ChatGPT for nearby Public Storage locations, unit sizes, and available storage features.


**Can ChatGPT Help Me Find a 10×10 Storage Unit?**
Yes. Ask ChatGPT for 10×10 unit options in your city or near a specific location. Confirm the selected unit’s details directly with Public Storage before renting.


**Can I Search for Climate-Controlled Storage in ChatGPT?**
Yes. Ask ChatGPT for nearby[climate-controlled storage](https://www.publicstorage.com/climate-controlled-storage) options. Confirm current unit availability with your selected Public Storage location.


**Can ChatGPT Help Me Choose a Storage Unit Size?**
Yes. ChatGPT can provide unit-size guidance based on the items you plan to store. You can also use the[Public Storage size guide](https://www.publicstorage.com/size-guide) to compare common unit sizes.


**Do I Still Need to Confirm My Rental Details With Public Storage?**
Yes. Confirm your selected location, unit size, available features, and rental details directly with Public Storage before completing a rental.
